title: Bunny with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='spark' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='22' rx='7' ry='17' fill='#f7c6d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='7' ry='17' fill='#f7c6d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='23' rx='3.5' ry='12' fill='#f28fb5'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='23' rx='3.5' ry='12' fill='#f28fb5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='26' fill='#fbe3ea'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='6' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='66' r='6' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='54' r='6.5' fill='#3a1f4d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='54' r='6.5' fill='#3a1f4d'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='url(#spark)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='url(#spark)'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='56.5' r='1.1' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='56.5' r='1.1' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M46 64 Q50 61 54 64 Q50 69 46 64 Z' fill='#f28fb5'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 68 Q46 73 42 70' stroke='#d9668f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 68 Q54 73 58 70' stroke='#d9668f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M22 62 L12 60' stroke='#f0b6cb' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M22 66 L12 67' stroke='#f0b6cb' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 62 L88 60' stroke='#f0b6cb' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 66 L88 67' stroke='#f0b6cb' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- extra sparkles around face -->
  <path d='M20 40 L21.5 44 L25 45.5 L21.5 47 L20 51 L18.5 47 L15 45.5 L18.5 44 Z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <path d='M80 44 L81 47 L84 48 L81 49 L80 52 L79 49 L76 48 L79 47 Z' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
</svg>
